description: The shadow alone (the text itself is transparent): a hard offset copy of the glyphs.

florui.css: .scene { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 70px; background-color: #f4e9d8; } .t { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 10px; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; color: transparent; text-shadow: 3px 3px #c1440e; }

classification.reason: Chromium and this engine draw the same font's glyphs with different rasterizers (the existing text fixtures are tolerant for that reason), so the glyph edges differ slightly in both the text and its shadow. Measured against desktop Chrome; geometry an exact match.
